title: Vietnamese Pork Belly Stir Fry
description: A delicious and flavorful stir fry dish that combines the sweetness of pork belly with the spices of Vietnam. It's a perfect meal for a cold evening.
instructions: 1. Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add the pork belly and fry until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
3. Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add more oil if necessary and stir-fry the chopped onion until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
6. Add the Vietnamese nochi and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until it starts to brown.
7. Add the cooked pork belly back into the skillet, along with the fish sauce, sugar, and soy sauce.
8. Stir-fry everything together for about 2-3 minutes, until the pork is coated in the sauce.
9. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
10. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
